Located just steps from the shore, this charming beach house offers exclusive private beach access, making it easy to lose yourself in the rhythm of the waves and find peace by the sea. Start your mornings with a quiet coffee on the spacious main-level porch, or sip cocktails in the fresh coastal air as the day winds down. For a breathtaking view, head up to the private balcony off the primary bedroom to take in the sparkling Gulf and soak in a serene sunset. Nestled less than a mile from Alys Beach, Beach Retreat invites you to slow down and explore by foot. Stroll to charming local cafes and boutique shops, discover hidden corners, or simply wander in search of nature’s beauty along this scenic stretch of 30A. With all the comforts of home, Beach Retreat is designed for peaceful moments with family and friends. Here, you can reconnect with loved ones and immerse yourself in the serenity of a beach escape that’s as effortless as it is unforgettable. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - PRIVATE beach access just a 1-2 minute walk! No crowds! - Direct access to the Timpoochee Trail which provides 18 miles to run/walk/bike to the seaside communities along 30A. - Easy access to Alys/Rosemary Beach to the East. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12) - King Bedroom: 1st floor- King bed with ensuite bathroom - Twin Bedroom: 1st floor- 2 Twin beds and daybed with ensuite bathroom - King Bedroom: 2nd floor - King bed with ensuite bathroom and private balcony with view - Bunk Room: 2nd floor - 2 Bunk sets (twin over full) with ensuite bathroom FEATURES - Private neighborhood beach access steps from this home - Full kitchen, walk in pantry, stainless steel appliances - Gas Grill - Outdoor shower - Beach Chairs, towels, toys, wagon - 4 Bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms - Smart TVs in each bedroom with Roku - Full-sized washer and dryer - Gulf View from balcony - Large comfortable living area - Large covered porch - Direct access to Timpoochee Trail, minutes to Alys beach - Discount provided for pontoon rentals and yacht charters, bike rentals and golf cart rentalsNeighborhoodThis small street is private and thus has access to a private beach. No crowds - no matter what time of year!
